name: FirstCardControls - BriefOnly
description: Startable from a page alone: something attached and NOTHING typed, with the send live anyway - the opposite of every other state here, because a page says what you want thought through so the sentence becomes optional. It is also the state where Add a link staying at full strength matters most: somebody who arrived with one page usually has a second, and this control used to dim here on the theory that a board has one brief. It no longer does - the pages merge into that one brief at start.
